post.summary: Creates a new customer in the system.
post.description:
This method validates and stores customer information, including basic details,
preferences, and any initial tags or notes. A unique customer ID is generated
and returned in the response.

Returns the created Customer object with all fields populated.
Throws INVALID_ARGUMENT if required fields are missing or invalid.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for creating a new customer.

get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific customer.
get.description:
Returns all customer data including preferences, notes, tags, and appointment history.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer to retrieve
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

put.description:
Modifies the details of an existing customer, including basic information,
preferences, and optionally updating associated tags or notes.

Returns the updated Customer object with all fields populated.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.
Throws INVALID_ARGUMENT if provided fields are invalid.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer to update
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

get.summary: Generates a secure link for adding customer card-on-file information.
get.description:
The generated link is valid for 24 hours and can only be used once.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Adds new notes to a customer's profile.
post.description:
Notes are timestamped and attributed to the staff member who created them.
Returns the newly created notes with generated IDs.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of notes for a specific customer.
post.description:
Notes are returned in reverse chronological order (newest first).
Returns an empty list if the customer has no notes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Adds new tags to a customer's profile.
post.description:
Tags help categorize customers and can be used for filtering and reporting.
Returns the newly created tags with generated IDs.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Retrieves all tags associated with a specific customer.
post.description:
Returns an empty list if the customer has no tags.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the customer
Required. Format: "cus_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Lists customers matching the specified criteria.
post.description:
Results are paginated and can be filtered by last update time.
Returns an empty list if no customers match the criteria.

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
or after the start.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
end.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

latitude.description: The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].

typeLatLng.description: An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this must conform to the WGS84 standard. Values must be within normalized ranges.

v1Address.description:
The address object represents a physical location used throughout the system.
It provides a standardized way to store and validate address information for
businesses, customers, and service locations. The address format follows
common postal standards and includes geocoding information for mapping.

v1AddressType.description:
- TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not intended for direct use. Indicates a system anomaly.
 - PRIMARY: Primary Address, which will be used as first address choice.
 - SECONDARY: Secondary Address, an optional address saved as back-up
v1AddressType.title:
Possible values are `primary`, `secondary`.
Type represents the importance of the address

v1Customer.description:
Customer represents a client who uses your services. A customer can have multiple pets,
appointments, and preferences. Customers are the core entity in the pet service business
and are used throughout the system for booking appointments, managing pets, and tracking
service history.

v1CustomerStatus.description:
Status represents the current state of a customer's account.
This affects their ability to book appointments and access services.

 - STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: STATUS_UNSPECIFIED indicates an unknown or invalid status.
New customers should not be created with this status.
 - ACTIVE: ACTIVE indicates the customer can book appointments and use services.
This is the default status for new customers.
 - INACTIVE: INACTIVE indicates the customer cannot book new appointments.
Existing appointments may still be honored based on business policy.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.
